title: CM asks Telangana to use water carefully for 8 months

slides.head: CM asks Telangana to use water carefully for 8 months
What happened
slides.body: CM Revanth Reddy on Friday urged people not to waste water over the next eight months, citing El Nino-driven low rainfall and drought.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: His office's release said dry conditions and no rains are expected for the next 8 months.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: Hyderabad sometimes gets 24 cm of rain in two hours, the CM said.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Climate Conclave at Bharat Future City, December 7-9, and details of the free auto-to-EV conversion. Ask: How will the free conversion of 2 lakh autos be funded?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
CM asks Telangana to use water carefully for 8 months

At the Climate Conclave curtain raiser, the CM urged careful water use for eight months due to El Nino, told farmers to avoid water-heavy crops and announced free EV conversion for 2 lakh diesel autos.

Why it matters: His office's release said dry conditions and no rains are expected for the next 8 months.

Source: Siasat. Image: Siasat
